title: ReLIFE
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Arata Kaizaki, 27, is drifting through part-time jobs after quitting an exploitative company. A researcher offers him a place in the ReLIFE experiment: a pill makes him look ten years younger so he can repeat a year of high school, a chance to fix what went wrong.
life_message: A good life means re-engaging with people and helping others rather than hiding from past pain.

content.note: Memories of workplace harassment and loss (Wikipedia).
Teen-level romance; an adult posing as a teen keeps his distance (Wikipedia).
Workplace harassment leading to a colleague's suicide shapes the protagonist (Wikipedia); AniList Rehabilitation 89%, Tragedy signal.
